not_ready_elsewhere.why: With stack forced on, T-6eed74e7a248a5-01 (pocket check, textiles_laundry__perception.json) fails on all 5 seeds. The receipt and lip balm put on a 0.5 x 0.35 m tray topple off (phys.fall, cause stack_toppled). statics.stack_verdict applies its centre-offset rule (|offset| > 0.3 x the lower footprint) to a small item lying wholly on a large portable support. All 141 tests pass with stack forced; the other 18 laws pass both spec files together (75/75).

Not electrical's law, but electrical cannot vouch for it. Forced on, statics.stack_verdict's oversize rule (STACK_OVERSIZE 1.25) topples a 0.155 m phone centred on a 0.10 m x 12 mm Qi pad. This fails test_qi_pad_charges_only_when_aligned, test_charging_a_swollen_battery_runs_away and T-dd0bf4a1707041-01 on all 5 seeds. With every other law forced, all electrical tests and specs pass. Oven racks are portable, so a dish on a rack counts as a stack. statics.clearance_above_m then uses the next rack position (oven shelf_heights every 6 cm: clearance 0.04 m) even when no rack sits there. With the law forced, opening the oven moves the dish onto the oven itself, where 'Crouch or kneel to grasp something this low' refuses it: 8 tests and T-1aea0c41439b0a-01 fail. Kernel request.

reported_not_ready.why: The kernel models a fast set-down as a 6 cm drop (h_eff 0.06 m), which is far below porcelain (0.4 m) and glass (0.5 m) tolerances, so it never chips stemware or porcelain on stone. Under the forced law, spec T-ce25a2474ffb3d-01 (wrong plan 'rushes and sets it down hard on marble') fails on seeds 0, 1 and 97, and test_fast_set_down_chips_fragile_ware_on_stone fails. Needs a kernel decision (a chip outcome for brittle rims on hard tops at fast speed) or a re-authored wrong plan.

breakages.problem: The same T-7d4006bda247ba-01 failure: the upright iron writes damage.heat_mark 0.5 on the ironing board.

breakages.problem: tests/test_physics_statics FallAndBreakTests.test_break_modes_follow_the_material fails with every domain loaded: a glass jar broken inside an intact opaque wrap becomes a shard field with shattered True.

breakages.problem: Shards are spread along the planned path of a walk the robot never finished.

breakages.problem: Hand-over burns: _after_hand_over counts a burn above a fixed 55 C while people's hot-handover model uses thermal.burn_seconds over a ~2 s grip (adult about 65 C, child 60 C), so the two counters disagree for 55-65 C.

breakages.problem: Generation-2 wind (about 6.8 m/s, gusts 10.2) blows hung rescue equipment off its post (ring_buoy 4 m), a hose off its hanger, 4 kg patio chairs 1.5-2.65 m and watering cans onto the patio's doorway cell (blocking every route), and a 1.5 kg doormat 11.6 m.
